channel.title: AI Foundations — Daily Audio Course
channel.description: Short daily AI lessons connected to the AI Foundations email course and Kindle library.
channel.itunes:author: AI Foundations
channel.itunes:summary: Every episode is the audio companion to the matching daily course email and Kindle chapter.

item.title: Day 35: Prompting as Interface Design
item.description: The audio companion to AI Foundations Day 35: Prompting as Interface Design and Kindle chapter Day 35. Learn how to think about prompts as a user interface for an AI system, so you can get clearer, more useful, and more reliable outputs.

item.title: Day 1: What AI Is (and What It Is Not)
item.description: The audio companion to AI Foundations Day 1: What AI Is (and What It Is Not) and Kindle chapter Day 1. By the end of today’s 8-12 minute lesson, you should be able to explain what AI is, what it is not, and how to think about AI systems without getting buried in technical jargon.
